english: Take this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
sesotho: Nka meriana ena hantle feela joalokaha ngaka e u laetse.

english: Do not take more than the recommended dose in 24 hours.
sesotho: U se ke ua nka tekanyo e fetang e khothalletsoang ka lihora tse 24.

english: Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water.
sesotho: Komela letlapa lohle ka khalase e tletseng metsi.

english: Do not crush or chew extended-release tablets.
sesotho: U se ke ua silafatsa kapa ua hlafuna lipilisi tse nang le tokollo e eketsehileng.

english: Take this medicine with food to reduce stomach upset.
sesotho: Nka moriana ona hammoho le lijo ho fokotsa ho teneha ha mpa.

english: Take this medicine on an empty stomach for best absorption.
sesotho: Nka moriana ona ka mpeng e se nang letho e le hore u o nke hantle.

english: Store this medication at room temperature away from heat and moisture.
sesotho: Boloka meriana ena mocheso oa kamore, u se ke ua e fumana mocheso le mongobo.

english: Keep all medications out of reach of children and pets.
sesotho: Boloka meriana eohle e sa fumanehe ho bana le liphoofolo tse ruuoang lapeng.

english: Do not share your medication with other people.
sesotho: U se ke ua bolella batho ba bang meriana ea hao.

english: Check the expiry date before taking any medication.
sesotho: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho felloa ke nako pele u noa meriana leha e le efe.

english: Dispose of expired medications safely at a pharmacy.
sesotho: Lahla meriana e felletsoeng ke nako ka tsela e sireletsehileng ka lebenkeleng la meriana.

english: Do not flush medications down the toilet unless instructed.
sesotho: U se ke ua lahlela meriana ea hao ka kamoreng ea ho hlapela ntle le haeba u laetsoe.

english: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
sesotho: Haeba u hloloheloa tekanyetso, e nke hang ha u hopola.

english: If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose.
sesotho: Haeba e se e le nako ea hore u noe tekanyetso e latelang, u se ke ua noa tekanyetso eo u sa kang ua e noa.

english: Never double your dose to make up for a missed one.
sesotho: Le ka mohla u se ke ua imetsa tekanyo ea hao ka makhetlo a mabeli e le hore u etse hore e be ea bohlokoa.

english: Tell your doctor about all other medications you are currently taking.
sesotho: Bolella ngaka ea hao ka meriana eohle eo u e nkang hona joale.

english: Some medications can interact with herbal supplements.
sesotho: Lithethefatsi tse ling li ka sebelisana le litlama.

english: Alcohol can increase the side effects of some medications.
sesotho: Joala bo ka eketsa litla-morao tsa meriana e meng.

english: Do not stop taking your medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho: U se ke ua khaotsa ho noa meriana ea hao ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english: Stopping antibiotics early can cause the infection to return.
sesotho: Ho khaotsa ho sebelisa lithibela-mafu kapele ho ka etsa hore tšoaetso e khutlele.

english: Complete the full course of antibiotics even if you feel better.
sesotho: Tlatsa meriana eohle ea lithibela-mafu esita le haeba u ikutloa u le betere.

english: Some medications cause drowsiness — do not drive after taking them.
sesotho: Meriana e meng e baka boroko  u se ke ua khanna ka mor'a ho e noa.

english: This medication may cause sensitivity to sunlight.
sesotho: Meriana ena e ka 'na ea etsa hore motho a ikutloe a sa sireletseha letsatsing.

english: Apply sunscreen when using medications that increase sun sensitivity.
sesotho: Sebelisa setlolo se sireletsang letsatsi ha u sebelisa meriana e eketsang kutloisiso ea hao letsatsing.

english: Shake the liquid medication well before each use.
sesotho: Tšosa meriana e metsi hantle pele u e sebelisa.

english: Use the measuring spoon provided — do not use a kitchen spoon.
sesotho: Sebelisa sekotlolo sa ho lekanya ha feela u sa sebelise sekotlolo sa kichineng.

english: Measure liquid medications carefully to avoid overdose.
sesotho: Hlahloba meriana e nang le metsi ka hloko e le hore u qobe ho e sebelisa ka tekanyo e feteletseng.

english: Store insulin in the refrigerator but never freeze it.
sesotho: Boloka insulin ka sehatsetsing empa u se ke ua e beha ka sehatsetsing.

english: Allow insulin to reach room temperature before injecting.
sesotho: Lumella insulin hore e fihle mocheso oa kamore pele e kenngoa.

english: Rotate injection sites to prevent skin thickening.
sesotho: Fetolela libaka tsa ente e le hore letlalo le se ke la ata.

english: Apply the patch to clean, dry, hairless skin.
sesotho: Sebelisa setlolo sena letlalong le hloekileng, le omileng, le se nang moriri.

english: Remove the old patch before applying a new one.
sesotho: Tlosa sekhomaretsi sa khale pele u se sebelisa.

english: Wash your hands before and after applying topical medication.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho pele le ka mor'a hore u sebelise meriana ea sebakeng seo.

english: Do not apply topical medication to broken or irritated skin.
sesotho: U se ke ua sebelisa meriana ea sebakeng seo letlalong le robehileng kapa le halefileng.

english: Eye drops should not touch the eye surface directly.
sesotho: Marotholi a mahlo ha aa lokela ho ama sefahleho sa mahlo ka kotloloho.

english: Tilt your head back and pull down the lower eyelid to apply eye drops.
sesotho: Beha hlooho ea hao ka morao 'me u theohele ka tlaase ho lesela la leihlo ho sebelisa marotholi a mahlo.

english: Wait at least five minutes between different eye drop medications.
sesotho: Ema bonyane metsotso e mehlano pakeng tsa meriana e fapaneng ea ho khaotsa ho noa.

english: Ear drops should be warmed to body temperature before use.
sesotho: Ho lokela ho futhumatsoa marotholi a tsebe ho fihlela mocheso oa 'mele pele a sebelisoa.

english: Lie on your side for five minutes after applying ear drops.
sesotho: Robala ka lehlakoreng la hao metsotso e mehlano ka mor'a hore u sebelise litlhapi tsa litsebe.

english: Nasal sprays should be directed away from the nasal septum.
sesotho: Li-spray tsa nko li lokela ho lebisoa hōle le nko ea nko.

english: Inhaled medications must be used with the correct technique.
sesotho: Meriana e kenang ka hare e lokela ho sebelisoa ka mokhoa o nepahetseng.

english: Rinse your mouth after using a steroid inhaler.
sesotho: Hlatsoa molomo ka mor'a hore u sebelise inhaler ea steroid.

english: Use a spacer with your metered-dose inhaler for better delivery.
sesotho: Sebelisa sebaka se nang le mochine oa ho hema o nang le litekanyetso tse lekantsoeng e le hore u fumane nako e molemo ea ho pepa.

english: Keep your inhaler clean and dry at all times.
sesotho: Boloka mochine oa hao oa ho hema o hloekile ebile o omme ka linako tsohle.

english: Check that your inhaler is not empty before use.
sesotho: Etsa bonnete ba hore ha u e-s'o sebelise setlolo sa hau sa ho hema.

english: Suppositories should be stored in a cool place.
sesotho: Li-suppositories li lokela ho bolokoa sebakeng se pholileng.

english: Wash hands thoroughly after handling suppositories.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho ka hloko ka mor'a hore u sebelise li-suppositori.

english: Some antibiotics reduce the effectiveness of oral contraceptives.
sesotho: Lithibela-mafu tse ling li fokotsa katleho ea lithibela-mafu tse sebelisoang ka molomo.

english: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant before starting any medication.
sesotho: Bolella ngaka ea hao haeba u imme pele u qala meriana leha e le efe.

english: Some medications are not safe to take during breastfeeding.
sesotho: Meriana e meng ha e bolokehe ho e noa nakong ea ho anyesa.

english: Report any allergic reaction to medication immediately.
sesotho: Tlaleha kapele ka karabelo leha e le efe e sa tloaelehang ea meriana.

english: Signs of allergic reaction include rash, swelling, and difficulty breathing.
sesotho: Matšoao a ho tepella ho feteletseng a kenyelletsa ho tsoa ha letlalo, ho ruruha le ho hema ka thata.

english: Seek emergency care if you experience severe chest pain after taking medication.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea tšohanyetso haeba u e-na le bohloko bo matla sefubeng ka mor'a ho noa meriana.

english: Do not take aspirin for fever in children under 16 years.
sesotho: U se ke ua noa aspirin bakeng sa feberu ho bana ba ka tlaase ho lilemo tse 16.

english: Paracetamol is safe for fever in children when given at the correct dose.
sesotho: Paracetamol e bolokehile bakeng sa feberu ho bana ha e fuoa ka tekanyo e nepahetseng.

english: Calculate the correct dose of children's medicine based on body weight.
sesotho: Hlahloba tekanyo e nepahetseng ea meriana ea bana e itšetlehileng ka boima ba 'mele.

english: Read the package insert carefully before taking any new medication.
sesotho: Bala lethathamo la meriana ka hloko pele u noa meriana leha e le efe e ncha.

english: Ask your pharmacist if you do not understand the dosage instructions.
sesotho: Botsa setsebi sa hau sa meriana haeba u sa utloisise litaelo tsa litekanyetso.

english: Keep a list of all your medications and carry it with you.
sesotho: Boloka lethathamo la meriana eohle ea hao 'me u e nke le uena.

english: Inform your dentist about all medications you are taking.
sesotho: Bolella ngaka ea meno ka meriana eohle eo u e nkang.

english: Some medications can affect the results of blood tests.
sesotho: Meriana e meng e ka ama liphello tsa liteko tsa mali.

english: Inform your doctor about any medications before having surgery.
sesotho: Bolella ngaka ea hao ka meriana leha e le efe pele u buuoa.

english: Do not take iron supplements with dairy products.
sesotho: U se ke ua nka lisebelisoa tsa tšepe hammoho le lihlahisoa tsa lebese.

english: Take calcium supplements at a different time from iron supplements.
sesotho: Nka li-supplement tsa calcium ka nako e fapaneng le ea tšepe.

english: Some medications must be taken at the same time every day.
sesotho: Meriana e meng e lokela ho nooa ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le letsatsi.

english: Set a daily alarm to help you remember to take your medication.
sesotho: Beha alamo ea letsatsi le letsatsi e tla u thusa ho hopola ho noa meriana ea hao.

english: A pill organizer can help you track your daily medications.
sesotho: Mookameli oa lipilisi a ka u thusa hore u latele meriana ea hao ea letsatsi le letsatsi.

english: Metformin should be taken with meals to reduce nausea.
sesotho: Metformin e lokela ho nooa hammoho le lijo ho fokotsa ho teneha.

english: Statins are usually taken at night for best effect.
sesotho: Hangata li-statin li nooa bosiu e le hore li ka ba le phello e ntle.

english: Blood pressure medication works best when taken at the same time daily.
sesotho: Meriana ea khatello ea mali e sebetsa hantle ha e nooa ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le letsatsi.

english: Thyroid medication should be taken first thing in the morning on an empty stomach.
sesotho: Meriana ea tšilo ea qoqotho e lokela ho nooa hoseng ka mpeng e se nang letho.

english: Warfarin requires regular blood tests to monitor your INR level.
sesotho: Warfarin e hloka ho hlahlojoa mali khafetsa ho lekola boemo ba hau ba INR.

english: Avoid foods high in vitamin K while taking warfarin.
sesotho: Qoba lijo tse nang le vithamine K ha u ntse u noa warfarin.

english: Do not take ibuprofen if you have kidney disease.
sesotho: U se ke ua noa ibuprofen haeba u na le lefu la liphio.

english: Avoid NSAIDs if you have a history of stomach ulcers.
sesotho: Qoba li-NSAID haeba u e-na le sefuba sa mpa.

english: Antacids can reduce the absorption of some antibiotics.
sesotho: Li-antacid li ka fokotsa ho monngoa ha lithibela-mafu tse ling.

english: Take antibiotics at evenly spaced intervals throughout the day.
sesotho: Nka lithibela-mafu ka nako e lekanang ho pholletsa le letsatsi.

english: Some medications require you to avoid grapefruit juice.
sesotho: Meriana e meng e hloka hore u qobe lero la grapefruit.

english: Grapefruit juice can increase the level of some drugs in your blood.
sesotho: Metsi a morara a ka eketsa litekanyetso tsa lithethefatsi tse ling maling a hao.

english: Pregnant women should attend at least eight antenatal visits.
sesotho: Basali baimana ba lokela ho ea bonyane libokeng tse robeli tsa pele ho tsoalo.

english: Start taking folic acid before you become pregnant.
sesotho: Qala ho noa folic acid pele u ima.

english: Take folic acid daily for the first three months of pregnancy.
sesotho: Nka folic acid letsatsi le leng le le leng likhoeling tse tharo tsa pele tsa bokhachane.

english: Folic acid reduces the risk of neural tube defects in the baby.
sesotho: Folic acid e fokotsa kotsi ea hore lesea le be le bokooa ba methapo ea kutlo.

english: Attend your first antenatal visit as early as possible in pregnancy.
sesotho: E-ba teng ketelong ea hao ea pele ho tsoalo kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang nakong ea bokhachane.

english: Iron supplements are recommended during pregnancy to prevent anaemia.
sesotho: Ho kgothaletswa ho nka litlatsetso tsa tšepe nakong ea bokhachane e le hore ho se ke ha e-ba le mali.

english: Calcium supplements support the baby's bone development.
sesotho: Lisebelisoa tsa khalsiamo li thusa masea ho hōla masapo.

english: Avoid alcohol completely during pregnancy.
sesotho: Qoba joala ka ho feletseng nakong ea bokhachane.

english: Do not smoke during pregnancy as it harms the baby.
sesotho: U se ke ua tsuba nakong ea bokhachane kaha ho kotsi ho lesea.

english: Avoid raw or undercooked meat during pregnancy.
sesotho: Qoba nama e tala kapa e sa phehiloeng hantle nakong ea bokhachane.

english: Do not eat unpasteurised cheese during pregnancy.
sesotho: U se ke ua ja chisi e sa phekoloa nakong ea bokhachane.

english: Listeria infection during pregnancy can harm the unborn baby.
sesotho: Ho tšoaetsoa ke Listeria nakong ea bokhachane ho ka senya lesea le e-s'o tsoaloe.

english: Sleep on your left side during the third trimester of pregnancy.
sesotho: Robala ka lehlakoreng le letšehali nakong ea likhoeli tse tharo tsa bokhachane.

english: Report any swelling of the face or hands during pregnancy to your doctor.
sesotho: Tsebisa ngaka ea hao ka ho ruruha ha sefahleho kapa matsoho nakong ea bokhachane.

english: High blood pressure during pregnancy can be dangerous.
sesotho: Khatello e phahameng ea mali nakong ea bokhachane e ka ba kotsi.

english: Pre-eclampsia requires immediate medical attention.
sesotho: Pele ho lefu la sethoathoa, ho hlokahala tlhokomelo e potlakileng ea bongaka.

english: Attend all scheduled ultrasound scans during pregnancy.
sesotho: E-ba teng litlhahlobong tsohle tse reriloeng tsa ultrasound nakong ea bokhachane.

english: The baby's movements should be felt daily from 28 weeks.
sesotho: Ho tloha libekeng tse 28 ho ea pele, motsamao oa lesea o lokela ho bonoa letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english: Report any reduction in baby movements to your midwife immediately.
sesotho: Tsebisa mooki oa hao hang-hang ka phokotso leha e le efe ea motsamao oa lesea.

english: Breastfeeding provides the best nutrition for newborn babies.
sesotho: Ho anyesa masea ho fana ka phepo e nepahetseng ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa.

english: Breast milk contains antibodies that protect the baby from infection.
sesotho: Lebese la 'mè le na le li-antibodies tse sireletsang lesea hore le se ke la tšoaetsoa.

english: Breastfeed your baby exclusively for the first six months.
sesotho: Fepa lesea la hao feela ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng tsa pele.

english: Feed your baby on demand — at least eight times in 24 hours.
sesotho: Fepa lesea la hao ha le batla  bonyane ka makhetlo a robeli ka lihora tse 24.

english: Ensure the baby latches correctly to prevent nipple pain.
sesotho: Etsa bonnete ba hore lesea le notlela hantle e le hore le se ke la utloa bohloko ba matsoele.

english: A good latch means the baby's mouth covers the areola, not just the nipple.
sesotho: Ho koaloa hantle ho bolela hore molomo oa lesea o koahela areola, eseng feela sefubeng.

english: Burp your baby after each feeding to release trapped air.
sesotho: Hlatsoa lesea la hao ka mor'a ho fepa ho lokolla moea o koetsoeng.

english: Introduce solid foods at six months alongside continued breastfeeding.
sesotho: Qala ho ja lijo tse tiileng ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng hammoho le ho anyesa.

english: Do not give honey to babies under one year of age.
sesotho: U se ke ua fa masea a ka tlaase ho selemo mahe a linotši.

english: Do not give cow's milk as the main drink before 12 months.
sesotho: U se ke ua fana ka lebese la khomo e le seno se ka sehloohong pele ho likhoeli tse 12.

english: Introduce one new food at a time to watch for allergic reactions.
sesotho: Tlisa lijo tse ncha ka nako e le 'ngoe e le hore u shebe hore na u na le mafu a ho kula.

english: Babies should sleep on their back to reduce the risk of sudden infant death.
sesotho: Lesea le lokela ho robala ka mokokotlo e le hore le fokotse kotsi ea lefu la tšohanyetso la masea.

english: Keep the baby's sleeping area free of pillows and loose bedding.
sesotho: Boloka sebaka seo lesea le robalang ho sona se se na li-pillow le libethe tse lokolohileng.

english: Do not share a bed with your baby if you smoke or drink alcohol.
sesotho: U se ke ua robala le ngoana oa hao haeba u tsuba kapa u noa joala.

english: Weigh your baby regularly to monitor healthy growth.
sesotho: Hlahisa lesea la hao khafetsa e le hore le hōle hantle.

english: A baby who is not gaining weight needs medical assessment.
sesotho: Ngoana ea sa ntseng a nona o hloka ho hlahlojoa ke ngaka.

english: All children should receive the full schedule of childhood vaccinations.
sesotho: Bana bohle ba lokela ho fumana kemiso e feletseng ea liente tsa bongoana.

english: The BCG vaccine protects against tuberculosis.
sesotho: Ente ea BCG e sireletsa khahlanong le lefuba.

english: The pentavalent vaccine protects against five serious diseases.
sesotho: Ente ea pentavalent e sireletsa maloetse a mahlano a tebileng.

english: The measles vaccine is given at nine months and 18 months.
sesotho: Ente ea masepelo e fuoa likhoeli tse robong le likhoeli tse 18.

english: The rotavirus vaccine prevents severe diarrhoea in infants.
sesotho: Ente ea rotavirus e thibela ho ruruha ho matla masea.

english: The pneumococcal vaccine protects against pneumonia and meningitis.
sesotho: Ente ea pneumococcal e sireletsa khahlanong le tšoaetso ea matšoafo le meningitis.

english: Bring your child's Road to Health booklet to every clinic visit.
sesotho: Tlisa bukana ea Tsela ea Bophelo bo Botle ea ngoana oa hao ha a etela tleliniki e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

english: Record all vaccinations in the child's health booklet.
sesotho: Ngola likokoana-hloko tsohle bukeng ea bophelo bo botle ba ngoana.

english: A child with a fever after vaccination can be given paracetamol.
sesotho: Ngoana ea nang le feberu ka mor'a ho entoa a ka fuoa paracetamol.

english: Mild redness at the injection site is normal after vaccination.
sesotho: Bofubelu bo bobebe sebakeng sa ente bo tloaelehile ka mor'a ho entoa.

english: Seek medical care if your child has a high fever after vaccination.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba ngoana oa hao a e-na le feberu e phahameng ka mor'a ho entoa.

english: Oral rehydration solution prevents dehydration from diarrhoea.
sesotho: Tharollo ea ho nosetsa metsi ka molomo e thibela ho senyeha ha metsi ka lebaka la letšollo.

english: Give oral rehydration solution after every loose stool.
sesotho: Fana ka tharollo ea ho nosetsa ka molomo ka mor'a hore setulo se lokolohe.

english: Continue breastfeeding during diarrhoea illness.
sesotho: Tsoela pele ho anyesa nakong ea lefu la letšollo.

english: Zinc supplements reduce the duration of diarrhoea in children.
sesotho: Lisebelisoa tsa zinki li fokotsa nako eo bana ba tšoaroang ke letšollo ka eona.

english: Wash hands with soap after changing nappies.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho ka sesepa ka mor'a ho fetola masela.

english: Clean the umbilical cord stump with clean water and keep it dry.
sesotho: Hlatsoa mohala oa khoele ka metsi a hloekileng 'me u o boloke o omme.

english: The umbilical cord stump falls off within two weeks.
sesotho: Ho se ho fetile libeke tse peli feela ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho se ho

english: Seek medical care if the umbilical cord stump becomes red or smells.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea bongaka haeba molala oa mohala oa mokokotlo o fetoha o mofubelu kapa o nkha hampe.

english: Newborns should be kept warm but not overheated.
sesotho: Bana ba sa tsoa tsoaloa ba lokela ho futhumala empa ba se ke ba futhumala haholo.

english: Skin-to-skin contact after birth helps regulate the baby's temperature.
sesotho: Ho kopana ha letlalo le letlalo ka mor'a hore lesea le tsoaloe ho thusa ho laola mocheso oa lesea.

english: Vitamin A supplementation is given to children every six months.
sesotho: Bana ba fuoa vithamine ea A ka mor'a likhoeli tse tšeletseng.

english: Deworming tablets are given to children over one year every six months.
sesotho: Lipilisi tse senyang likokoanyana li fuoa bana ba lilemo li fetang selemo se le seng ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng.

english: Growth monitoring detects malnutrition early.
sesotho: Tlhokomelo ea kgolo e lemoha ho se je hantle ha lijo pele ho nako.

english: A child with severe acute malnutrition needs urgent medical care.
sesotho: Ngoana ea kulang haholo o hloka tlhokomelo ea bongaka ka potlako.

english: Therapeutic feeding programmes treat severe malnutrition in children.
sesotho: Mananeo a phekolo ea lijo a phekola ho se je hantle ho hoholo ha bana.

english: Children with HIV should receive all routine vaccinations.
sesotho: Bana ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba lokela ho entoa kamehla.

english: HIV-positive mothers can breastfeed if they are on antiretroviral therapy.
sesotho: Bo-'mè ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba ka anyesa haeba ba fuoa kalafo ea lithibela-mafu.

english: Prevention of mother-to-child transmission reduces HIV in newborns.
sesotho: Ho thibela ho fetisoa ha HIV ho tloha ho 'mè ho ea ho ngoana ho fokotsa HIV ho masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa.

english: All pregnant women should be tested for HIV.
sesotho: Basali bohle baimana ba lokela ho hlahlojoa hore na ba na le HIV.

english: Start antiretroviral therapy immediately if you test HIV positive during pregnancy.
sesotho: Qala kalafo ea antiretroviral hang-hang haeba u e-na le teko ea HIV nakong ea bokhachane.

english: Nevirapine syrup is given to HIV-exposed newborns after birth.
sesotho: Nevirapine syrup e fuoa masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa a nang le HIV ka mor'a hore a tsoaloe.

english: All HIV-exposed infants should be tested at six weeks of age.
sesotho: Bana bohle ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba lokela ho hlahlojoa ha ba le libeke tse tšeletseng.

english: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis protects HIV-exposed infants from infections.
sesotho: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis e sireletsa masea a nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ho tšoaetso.

english: Regular developmental checks monitor the child's milestones.
sesotho: Ho hlahlojoa tsoelo-pele ea ngoana kamehla ho hlahloba hore na o na le nako e kae a ntse a hōla.

english: Delayed milestones should be assessed by a healthcare professional.
sesotho: Likarolo tsa bohlokoa tse ileng tsa lieha li lokela ho hlahlojoa ke setsebi sa tlhokomelo ea bophelo.

english: Play and stimulation are essential for healthy brain development.
sesotho: Ho bapala le ho susumetsa ke tsa bohlokoa hore boko bo hōle hantle.

english: Read and talk to your baby from birth to support language development.
sesotho: Bala 'me u buisane le lesea la hao ho tloha ha le hlaha e le hore le tšehetse tsoelo-pele ea puo.

english: A safe home environment prevents childhood accidents and injuries.
sesotho: Tikoloho e sireletsehileng ea lapeng e thibela likotsi le likotsi tsa bongoaneng.

english: Keep sharp objects and cleaning products locked away from children.
sesotho: Boloka lintho tse bohale le lintho tse hloekisang li le hōle le bana.

english: Teach children to wash their hands before eating and after using the toilet.
sesotho: Ruta bana ho hlapa matsoho pele ba ja le ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntloana.

english: Ensure children drink clean, safe water at all times.
sesotho: Etsa bonnete ba hore bana ba noa metsi a hloekileng le a bolokehileng ka linako tsohle.

english: School-age children should receive regular eye and hearing checks.
sesotho: Bana ba lilemong tsa sekolo ba lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla.

english: Tuberculosis is spread through the air when an infected person coughs.
sesotho: Lefuba le hasana moeeng ha motho ea tšoaelitsoeng a khohlela.

english: TB symptoms include a persistent cough lasting more than two weeks.
sesotho: Matšoao a TB a kenyelletsa ho khohlela ka nako e telele ho feta libeke tse peli.

english: Cough into your elbow or a tissue to prevent spreading infection.
sesotho: Ho khohlela ka mokokotlong kapa ka har'a lesela ho thibela tšoaetso hore e se ke ea ata.

english: Open windows to improve ventilation and reduce TB transmission.
sesotho: Bula lifensetere ho ntlafatsa moea o kenang le ho fokotsa ho fetisoa ha TB.

english: TB is curable with a full course of treatment lasting six months.
sesotho: Lefuba le ka phekoloa ka phekolo e feletseng ea likhoeli tse tšeletseng.

english: Do not stop TB treatment early even if you feel better.
sesotho: U se ke ua khaotsa ho phekola TB kapele le haeba u ikutloa u le betere.

english: Drug-resistant TB requires a longer and more complex treatment.
sesotho: Lefuba le sa sebetseng lithethefatsi le hloka kalafo e telele le e rarahaneng haholoanyane.

english: HIV-positive people have a higher risk of developing TB.
sesotho: Batho ba nang le tšoaetso ea HIV ba kotsing e kholo ea ho tšoaroa ke lefuba.

english: Isoniazid preventive therapy reduces the risk of TB in HIV patients.
sesotho: Kalafo ea thibelo ea isoniazid e fokotsa kotsi ea ho tšoaroa ke lefuba ho bakuli ba nang le HIV.

english: HIV is transmitted through unprotected sex, blood, and from mother to child.
sesotho: HIV e fetisoa ka thobalano e sa sireletsoang, mali le ho tloha ho 'mè ho ea ho ngoana.

english: HIV is not transmitted through casual contact, hugging, or sharing food.
sesotho: HIV ha e fetisoe ka ho kopana le motho ka linako tse ling, ka ho mo haka kapa ka ho ja hammoho.

english: Use a condom every time you have sex to prevent HIV.
sesotho: Sebelisa k'hontomo nako le nako ha u kopanela liphate ho thibela tšoaetso ea HIV.

english: Male circumcision reduces the risk of HIV transmission.
sesotho: Lebollo la banna le fokotsa kotsi ea ho fetisoa ha HIV.

english: Pre-exposure prophylaxis reduces the risk of HIV infection.
sesotho: Thibelo ea ho itšireletsa mafung pele ho ho pepeseha e fokotsa kotsi ea tšoaetso ea HIV.

english: Test for HIV at least once a year if you are sexually active.
sesotho: Ho hlahlojoa HIV bonyane hang ka selemo haeba u kopanela liphate.

english: Antiretroviral therapy suppresses HIV and prevents transmission.
sesotho: Kalafo ea antiviral e thibela tšoaetso ea HIV le ho e fetisetsa.

english: An undetectable viral load means you cannot transmit HIV sexually.
sesotho: Ho ba le moroalo oa vaerase o sa fumanoeng ho bolela hore u ke ke ua fetisetsa HIV ka thobalano.

english: Take antiretroviral medication every day at the same time.
sesotho: Nka meriana e khahlanong le li-retroviral letsatsi le leng le le leng ka nako e tšoanang.

english: Never stop antiretroviral therapy without consulting your doctor.
sesotho: Le ka mohla u se ke ua emisa kalafo ea antiretroviral ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english: Adherence to ART allows people with HIV to live long, healthy lives.
sesotho: Ho latela ART ho etsa hore batho ba nang le HIV ba phele bophelo bo bolelele le bo phetseng hantle.

english: Malaria is caused by a parasite transmitted through mosquito bites.
sesotho: Malaria e bakoa ke likokoana-hloko tse fetisoang ke ho loma ha mosquito.

english: Sleep under an insecticide-treated bed net every night.
sesotho: Robala tlas'a letlooa la bethe le phekotsoeng ka likokoanyana bosiu bo bong le bo bong.

english: Spray the inside of your home with insecticide to kill mosquitoes.
sesotho: Tšela likokoanyana tse bolaeang likokoanyana ka hare ho ntlo ea hao.

english: Remove standing water around your home to prevent mosquito breeding.
sesotho: Tlosa metsi a emeng a pota-potileng ntlo ea hao e le hore u se ke ua tšoasa litšitšili.

english: Seek medical care immediately if you develop fever after possible malaria exposure.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang-hang haeba u e-na le feberu ka mor'a hore u pepese malaria.

english: Malaria in pregnancy increases the risk of low birth weight.
sesotho: Malaria nakong ea bokhachane e eketsa kotsi ea ho ba le boima bo tlaase ha motho a hlaha.

english: Intermittent preventive treatment protects pregnant women from malaria.
sesotho: Kalafo ea thibelo e sa khaotseng e sireletsa basali baimana ho malaria.

english: Cholera is spread through contaminated water and food.
sesotho: Kholera e hasana ka metsi le lijo tse silafetseng.

english: Drink only boiled or treated water to prevent cholera.
sesotho: Noa feela metsi a belang kapa a phekotsoeng ho thibela k'holera.

english: Wash hands with soap and water before preparing food.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho ka sesepa le metsi pele u lokisetsa lijo.

english: Cook food thoroughly to kill harmful bacteria.
sesotho: Pheha lijo ka hloko e le hore u bolaee libaktheria tse kotsi.

english: Refrigerate leftover food promptly to prevent bacterial growth.
sesotho: Hang-hang beha lijo tse setseng ka sehatsetsing e le hore libaktheria li se ke tsa hōla.

english: Typhoid fever is prevented by safe water and food hygiene.
sesotho: Lefuba la typhoid le thibeloa ka metsi a hloekileng le bohloeki ba lijo.

english: Hepatitis B is spread through blood and sexual contact.
sesotho: Hepatitis B e hasana ka mali le ka ho kopanela liphate.

english: The hepatitis B vaccine is safe and highly effective.
sesotho: Ente ea hepatitis B e bolokehile ebile e sebetsa hantle haholo.

english: Hepatitis C can be cured with a short course of antiviral medication.
sesotho: Hepatitis C e ka phekoloa ka meriana e khahlanong le vaerase ka nako e khutšoanyane.

english: Sexually transmitted infections increase the risk of HIV transmission.
sesotho: Likokoana-hloko tse tšoaetsanoang ka thobalano li eketsa kotsi ea ho fetisoa ha HIV.

english: Get tested for sexually transmitted infections regularly if sexually active.
sesotho: Etsa tlhahlobo ea mafu a tšoaetsanoang ka thobalano khafetsa haeba u kopanela liphate.

english: Many sexually transmitted infections have no symptoms.
sesotho: Batho ba bangata ba tšoaetsanoang ka thobalano ha ba na matšoao.

english: Gonorrhoea and chlamydia can cause infertility if left untreated.
sesotho: Gonorrhea le chlamydia li ka baka ho se be le bana haeba li sa phekoloe.

english: Syphilis can be treated with penicillin if detected early.
sesotho: Syphilis e ka phekoloa ka penicillin haeba e fumanoa pele ho nako.

english: Meningitis is a medical emergency — seek care immediately.
sesotho: Meningitis ke boemo ba tšohanyetso ba bongaka  batla tlhokomelo hang-hang.

english: Symptoms of meningitis include stiff neck, fever, and sensitivity to light.
sesotho: Matšoao a meningitis a kenyelletsa ho thatafala ha molala, feberu le ho ba le kutloisiso ea leseli.

english: The meningococcal vaccine protects against bacterial meningitis.
sesotho: Ente ea meningococcal e sireletsa khahlanong le meningitis ea baktheria.

english: COVID-19 is spread through respiratory droplets and close contact.
sesotho: COVID-19 e hasana ka marotholi a phefumoloho le ho kopana haufi-ufi.

english: Wear a mask in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces.
sesotho: Apara maske libakeng tse tletseng batho kapa tse nang le moea o fokolang.

english: Wash your hands frequently with soap for at least 20 seconds.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho a hao khafetsa ka sesepa bonyane metsotsoana e 20.

english: Stay home if you are sick to prevent spreading infection to others.
sesotho: Lula hae haeba u kula e le hore u se ke ua fetisetsa tšoaetso ho ba bang.

english: COVID-19 vaccination reduces the risk of severe illness.
sesotho: Ente ea COVID-19 e fokotsa kotsi ea ho kula haholo.

english: Influenza vaccination is recommended annually for high-risk groups.
sesotho: Ho khothalletsoa ho entoa selemo le selemo bakeng sa batho ba kotsing e kholo ea ho tšoaroa ke sefuba.

english: Pneumonia can be prevented by vaccination and good hygiene.
sesotho: Pneumonia e ka thibeloa ka ho entoa le bohloeki bo botle.

english: Seek medical care early if you have difficulty breathing.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea bongaka esale pele haeba u e-na le bothata ba ho hema.

english: Diarrhoea spreads through contaminated water, food, and hands.
sesotho: Lefuba le ata ka metsi a silafetseng, lijo le matsoho.

english: Boil drinking water if you are unsure of its safety.
sesotho: Pheha metsi a nooang haeba u sa kholiseha ka polokeho ea ona.

english: Use a clean latrine and wash hands after using the toilet.
sesotho: Sebelisa ntloana e hloekileng 'me u hlatsoe matsoho ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntloana.

english: Schistosomiasis is prevented by avoiding contact with contaminated water.
sesotho: Schistosomiasis e thibeloa ka ho qoba ho kopana le metsi a silafetseng.

english: Intestinal worms are prevented by wearing shoes and washing hands.
sesotho: Ho thibela likokoana-hloko tsa mala ke ho apara lieta le ho hlatsoa matsoho.

english: Rabies is transmitted through the bite or scratch of an infected animal.
sesotho: Bohale bo fetisoa ka ho loma kapa ho hlohlona ha phoofolo e tšoaelitsoeng.

english: Seek medical care immediately after any animal bite.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka hang-hang ka mor'a hore phoofolo e je.

english: Wash an animal bite wound thoroughly with soap and water for 15 minutes.
sesotho: Hlatsoa leqeba la ho loma ha phoofolo ka sesepa le metsi ka metsotso e 15.

english: Post-exposure prophylaxis after animal bite prevents rabies.
sesotho: Ho thibela mafu ka mor'a hore phoofolo e je ho thibela ho tšoaroa ke rabies.

english: Tetanus is prevented by vaccination and wound care.
sesotho: Tetanus e thibeloa ka ho entoa le ho hlokomela maqeba.

english: Clean all wounds thoroughly to prevent tetanus infection.
sesotho: Hloekisa maqeba 'ohle ka hloko ho thibela tšoaetso ea tetanus.

english: Ebola is spread through direct contact with blood and body fluids.
sesotho: Ebola e hasana ka ho kopana ka ho toba le mali le metsi a 'mele.

english: Wear protective equipment when caring for patients with Ebola.
sesotho: Apara lisebelisoa tsa ho itšireletsa ha u hlokomela bakuli ba nang le Ebola.

english: Isolate patients with suspected Ebola immediately.
sesotho: Qoba hang-hang bakuli ba belaelloang ka Ebola.

english: Dengue fever is spread by daytime-biting mosquitoes.
sesotho: Lefu la dengue le fetisoa ke menoang e loma motšehare.

english: There is no specific treatment for dengue — manage symptoms and stay hydrated.
sesotho: Ha ho na phekolo e tobileng ea lefu la dengue  laola matšoao le ho lula u le metsi.

english: Seek medical care if dengue symptoms worsen rapidly.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea bongaka haeba matšoao a lefu la dengue a mpefala ka potlako.

english: Leprosy is curable with multidrug therapy.
sesotho: Lefuba le ka phekoloa ka meriana e mengata.

english: Early treatment of leprosy prevents permanent disability.
sesotho: Kalafo ea pele ea lepera e thibela bokooa bo sa foleng.

english: Trachoma is prevented by face washing and environmental hygiene.
sesotho: Trachoma e thibeloa ka ho hlatsoa sefahleho le bohloeki ba tikoloho.

english: River blindness is prevented by avoiding fast-flowing rivers in endemic areas.
sesotho: Ho foufala ha linōka ho thibeloa ka ho qoba linōka tse phallang ka potlako libakeng tse nang le baahi.

english: Sleeping sickness is transmitted by the tsetse fly.
sesotho: Lefu la boroko le fetisoa ke ntša ea tsetse.

english: Lymphatic filariasis is prevented by taking annual preventive medication.
sesotho: Lymphatic filariasis e ka thibeloa ka ho noa meriana ea selemo le selemo ea thibelo.

english: Soil-transmitted helminths affect millions of school-age children worldwide.
sesotho: Li-helminths tse fetisoang ke mobu li ama bana ba limilione ba kenang sekolo lefatšeng ka bophara.

english: Mass drug administration reduces the burden of neglected tropical diseases.
sesotho: Ho sebelisoa ha lithethefatsi ka bongata ho fokotsa moroalo oa maloetse a tropike a hlokomolohuoang.

english: Good hand hygiene is the single most effective way to prevent infection.
sesotho: Bohloeki bo botle ba matsoho ke eona tsela e atlehang ka ho fetisisa ea ho thibela tšoaetso.

english: Diabetes requires regular monitoring of blood glucose levels.
sesotho: Lefu la tsoekere le hloka hore ho be le leihlo la kamehla la tsoekere maling.

english: Check your blood glucose before meals and at bedtime.
sesotho: Hlahloba tsoekere ea hao ea mali pele u ja le pele u robala.

english: Keep a record of your blood glucose readings to share with your doctor.
sesotho: Boloka rekoto ea litekanyo tsa hao tsa tsoekere ea mali e le hore u e arolelane le ngaka ea hao.

english: A fasting blood glucose above 7 mmol/L may indicate diabetes.
sesotho: Ho ba le tsoekere ea mali e fetang 7 mmol/L ka ho itima lijo ho ka bontša lefu la tsoekere.

english: HbA1c measures your average blood glucose over three months.
sesotho: HbA1c e lekanya tsoekere ea hao ea mali ka likhoeli tse tharo.

english: Aim for an HbA1c below 7% to reduce diabetes complications.
sesotho: Leka ho fumana HbA1c e ka tlaase ho 7% ho fokotsa mathata a lefu la tsoekere.

english: Diabetes complications include kidney disease, blindness, and nerve damage.
sesotho: Mathata a lefu la tsoekere a akarelletsa lefu la liphio, bofofu le ho senyeha ha methapo.

english: Check your feet daily for cuts, blisters, or sores.
sesotho: Hlahloba maoto a hao letsatsi le leng le le leng hore na a na le likotoana, maqeba kapa maqeba.

english: Wear comfortable, well-fitting shoes to protect your feet.
sesotho: Apara lieta tse phutholohileng le tse loketseng ho sireletsa maoto a hao.

english: Never walk barefoot if you have diabetes.
sesotho: Le ka mohla u se ke ua tsamaea u se na maoto haeba u na le lefu la tsoekere.

english: Attend a diabetic eye screening every year.
sesotho: E-ba teng tlhahlobisong ea mahlo a lefu la tsoekere selemo le selemo.

english: High blood pressure often has no symptoms and must be checked regularly.
sesotho: Hangata khatello e phahameng ea mali ha e na matšoao 'me e lokela ho hlahlojoa kamehla.

english: Blood pressure above 140/90 mmHg requires treatment.
sesotho: Khatello ea mali e fetang 140/ 90 mmHg e hloka phekolo.

english: Reduce salt intake to lower blood pressure.
sesotho: Fokotsa letsoai le sebelisoang ho theola khatello ea mali.

english: The DASH diet helps control blood pressure naturally.
sesotho: Lijo tsa DASH li thusa ho laola khatello ea mali ka tlhaho.

english: Regular physical activity lowers blood pressure.
sesotho: Ho ikoetlisa kamehla ho fokotsa khatello ea mali.

english: Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise per week.
sesotho: Iphe pakane ea ho ikoetlisa bonyane metsotso e 150 ka beke.

english: Lose weight if you are overweight to improve blood pressure control.
sesotho: Fokotsa boima ba 'mele haeba u na le boima bo feteletseng e le hore u ka laola khatello ea mali.

english: Quit smoking to reduce the risk of heart disease and stroke.
sesotho: Khaotsa ho tsuba e le hore u fokotse kotsi ea ho tšoaroa ke lefu la pelo le stroke.

english: Smoking doubles the risk of heart attack.
sesotho: Ho tsuba ho etsa hore motho a be kotsing e imenne habeli ea ho hlaseloa ke pelo.

english: Reduce alcohol consumption to lower blood pressure.
sesotho: Fokotsa ho noa joala ho fokotsa khatello ea mali.

english: Take blood pressure medication every day even if you feel well.
sesotho: Nka meriana ea khatello ea mali letsatsi le leng le le leng esita le haeba u ikutloa hantle.

english: Never stop blood pressure medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho: Le ka mohla u se ke ua emisa meriana ea khatello ea mali ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english: High cholesterol increases the risk of heart attack and stroke.
sesotho: Ho ba le k'holeseterole e phahameng ho eketsa kotsi ea lefu la pelo le stroke.

english: A healthy diet low in saturated fat reduces cholesterol.
sesotho: Lijo tse phetseng hantle tse se nang mafura a mangata li fokotsa k'holeseterole.

english: Statins are effective at lowering cholesterol and preventing heart attacks.
sesotho: Li-statin li thusa ho theola k'holeseterole le ho thibela lefu la pelo.

english: Chest pain that spreads to the arm or jaw may be a heart attack.
sesotho: Bohloko ba sefubeng bo fetelang letsohong kapa mohlaheng bo ka 'na ba baka lefu la pelo.

english: Call emergency services immediately if you suspect a heart attack.
sesotho: Bitsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso hang-hang haeba u belaela hore u na le lefu la pelo.

english: Chew an aspirin immediately if you suspect a heart attack.
sesotho: Haeba u belaela hore u na le lefu la pelo, u lokela ho hlafuna aspirin hang-hang.

english: Stroke symptoms include sudden face drooping, arm weakness, and speech difficulty.
sesotho: Matšoao a stroke a kenyelletsa ho oa ha sefahleho ka tšohanyetso, ho fokola ha matsoho le ho thatafalloa ke ho bua.

english: Act FAST — Face, Arms, Speech, Time — if you suspect a stroke.
sesotho: Etsa lintho kapele  Sefahleho, matsoho, puo, nako  haeba u belaela hore u na le stroke.

english: Every minute counts during a stroke — seek emergency care immediately.
sesotho: Motsotso o mong le o mong o bohlokoa nakong ea stroke  batla thuso ea tšohanyetso hang-hang.

english: Asthma is a chronic condition that causes breathing difficulties.
sesotho: Asthma ke boemo bo sa foleng bo bakang mathata a ho hema.

english: Identify and avoid your asthma triggers.
sesotho: Khetholla le ho qoba lintho tse bakang lefu la hao la asma.

english: Common asthma triggers include dust, pollen, smoke, and exercise.
sesotho: Lintho tse tloaelehileng tse bakang lefu la asma li akarelletsa lerōle, phofo ea phofo, mosi le ho ikoetlisa.

english: Use your reliever inhaler when you have asthma symptoms.
sesotho: Sebelisa inhaler ea hao ea ho imolla ha u e-na le matšoao a lefu la asma.

english: Use your preventer inhaler every day even when you feel well.
sesotho: Sebelisa inhaler ea hao ea thibelo letsatsi le leng le le leng esita le ha u ikutloa hantle.

english: Seek emergency care if your reliever inhaler is not helping.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea tšohanyetso haeba sesebelisoa sa hao sa ho hema se sa thuse.

english: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is caused mainly by smoking.
sesotho: Ho tsuba ke sesosa se seholo sa lefu la matšoafo le thibelang ho tsuba.

english: Quitting smoking is the most important treatment for COPD.
sesotho: Ho khaotsa ho tsuba ke phekolo ea bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ea COPD.

english: Pulmonary rehabilitation improves breathing and quality of life in COPD.
sesotho: Ho tsosolosoa ha matšoafo ho ntlafatsa phefumoloho le boleng ba bophelo ho COPD.

english: Epilepsy is a neurological condition that causes recurrent seizures.
sesotho: Epilepsy ke lefu la methapo ea kutlo le bakang ho tšoaroa ke mafu a tšoaetsanoang.

english: Take epilepsy medication every day to prevent seizures.
sesotho: Nka meriana ea lefu la sethoathoa letsatsi le leng le le leng e le hore u qobe ho tšoaroa ke sefuba.

english: Do not stop epilepsy medication suddenly as this can trigger seizures.
sesotho: U se ke ua emisa meriana ea ho tšoaroa ke lefu la sethoathoa ka tšohanyetso kaha sena se ka baka lintoa.

english: During a seizure, protect the person from injury but do not restrain them.
sesotho: Nakong ea tlhaselo, sireletsa motho eo hore a se ke a lemala empa u se ke ua mo thibela.

english: Do not put anything in the mouth of a person having a seizure.
sesotho: U se ke ua kenya ntho leha e le efe ka hanong la motho ea nang le tlhaselo.

english: Place the person in the recovery position after a seizure.
sesotho: Etsa hore motho eo a fole ka mor'a hore a tšoaroe ke sefuba.

english: Seek emergency care if a seizure lasts more than five minutes.
sesotho: Batla thuso ea tšohanyetso haeba tlhaselo e nka nako e fetang metsotso e mehlano.

english: Mental health conditions are medical conditions that require treatment.
sesotho: Maemo a bophelo bo botle ba kelello ke maemo a bongaka a hlokang phekolo.

english: Depression is treatable with medication, therapy, or both.
sesotho: Ho tepella maikutlo ho ka phekoloa ka meriana, phekolo kapa ka bobeli.

english: Do not stop antidepressant medication without consulting your doctor.
sesotho: U se ke ua khaotsa ho noa meriana e loantšang khatello ea maikutlo ntle le ho buisana le ngaka ea hao.

english: Seek help immediately if you have thoughts of harming yourself.
sesotho: Batla thuso hang-hang haeba u na le menahano ea ho intša kotsi.

english: Schizophrenia requires long-term medication and support.
sesotho: Schizophrenia e hloka meriana le tšehetso ea nako e telele.

english: Kidney disease can be prevented by controlling blood pressure and diabetes.
sesotho: Mafu a liphio a ka thibeloa ka ho laola khatello ea mali le lefu la tsoekere.

english: Drink adequate water to support kidney function.
sesotho: Noa metsi a lekaneng ho tšehetsa mosebetsi oa liphio.

english: Reduce protein intake if you have advanced kidney disease.
sesotho: Fokotsa liprotheine haeba u e-na le lefu la liphio le tsoetseng pele.

english: Dialysis replaces the function of the kidneys when they fail.
sesotho: Li-dialysis li nka sebaka sa mosebetsi oa liphio ha li hloleha.

english: A kidney transplant can restore normal kidney function.
sesotho: Ho fetisoa ha liphio ho ka tsosolosa ts'ebetso e tloaelehileng ea liphio.

english: Liver disease can be caused by alcohol, hepatitis, and obesity.
sesotho: Lefu la sebete le ka bakoa ke joala, lefu la sebete le botenya.

english: Avoid alcohol completely if you have liver disease.
sesotho: Qoba joala ka ho feletseng haeba u e-na le lefu la sebete.

english: Fatty liver disease is reversed by weight loss and healthy eating.
sesotho: Ho lahleheloa ke boima ba 'mele le ho ja lijo tse phetseng hantle ho ka khutlisa lefu la sebete le mafura.

english: Cancer screening detects cancer early when it is most treatable.
sesotho: Tlhahlobo ea kankere e lemoha kankere e sa le hoseng ha e ka phekoloa hantle.

english: Cervical cancer is prevented by HPV vaccination and regular Pap smears.
sesotho: Kankere ea molala oa popelo e thibeloa ka ho entoa ka HPV le ka ho hlahlojoa kamehla ka Pap smears.

english: Breast cancer screening involves a mammogram every two years after age 40.
sesotho: Ho hlahloba kankere ea matsoele ho akarelletsa ho etsa mammogram lilemo tse ling le tse ling tse peli ka mor'a lilemo tse 40.

english: Colorectal cancer screening is recommended from age 45.
sesotho: Ho kgothaletswa hore motho a hlahlojoe kankere ea makhopho ho tloha ha a le lilemo li 45.

english: Prostate cancer screening involves a PSA blood test.
sesotho: Ho hlahloba kankere ea senya ho akarelletsa tlhahlobo ea mali ea PSA.

english: Skin cancer is prevented by using sunscreen and avoiding excessive sun exposure.
sesotho: Kankere ea letlalo e ka thibeloa ka ho sebelisa setlolo se sireletsang letsatsi le ho qoba ho pepesehela letsatsi ka ho feteletseng.

english: Oral cancer risk is increased by smoking and alcohol.
sesotho: Ho tsuba le ho noa joala ho eketsa kotsi ea kankere ea molomo.

english: Chemotherapy kills cancer cells but also affects healthy cells.
sesotho: Kalafo ea lik'hemik'hale e bolaea lisele tsa mofetše empa e boetse e ama lisele tse phetseng hantle.

english: Radiation therapy uses high-energy rays to destroy cancer cells.
sesotho: Kalafo ea mahlaseli e sebelisa mahlaseli a matla ho senya lisele tsa kankere.

english: Palliative care focuses on comfort and quality of life for serious illness.
sesotho: Tlhokomelo ea ho imoloha e lebisa tlhokomelo matšelisong le boleng ba bophelo bakeng sa mafu a tebileng.

english: Hospice care supports patients and families at the end of life.
sesotho: Tlhokomelo ea hospice e tšehetsa bakuli le malapa qetellong ea bophelo.

english: Anaemia causes fatigue, weakness, and shortness of breath.
sesotho: Anemia e baka mokhathala, bofokoli le phefumoloho e thata.

english: Iron-deficiency anaemia is treated with iron supplements and dietary changes.
sesotho: Anemia e nang le khaello ea tšepe e phekoloa ka litlatsetso tsa tšepe le liphetoho lijong.

english: Sickle cell disease is a genetic blood disorder requiring lifelong management.
sesotho: Lefu la lisele tsa sickle ke lefu la lefutso la mali le hlokang ho phekoloa bophelo bohle.

english: Hydroxyurea reduces the frequency of sickle cell crises.
sesotho: Hydroxyurea e fokotsa ho ata ha linokoane tse nang le lisele tsa mokokotlo.

english: Gout is caused by high uric acid levels in the blood.
sesotho: Gout e bakoa ke maemo a phahameng a uric acid maling.

english: Reduce red meat and alcohol intake to lower uric acid levels.
sesotho: Fokotsa ho ja nama e khubelu le joala e le hore u fokotse litekanyetso tsa uric acid.

english: Allopurinol lowers uric acid levels and prevents gout attacks.
sesotho: Allopurinol e fokotsa litekanyo tsa uric acid 'me e thibela ho hlaseloa ke gout.

english: Osteoporosis is prevented by adequate calcium and vitamin D intake.
sesotho: Osteoporosis e thibeloa ka ho noa k'halsiamo le vithamine D ka ho lekaneng.

english: Eat a variety of foods from all food groups every day.
sesotho: Ja lijo tse sa tšoaneng tse tsoang lihlopheng tsohle tsa lijo letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english: Fruits and vegetables provide essential vitamins and minerals.
sesotho: Litholoana le meroho li fana ka livithamini le liminerale tsa bohlokoa.

english: Eat at least five portions of fruit and vegetables per day.
sesotho: Ja litholoana le meroho bonyane ka makhetlo a mahlano ka letsatsi.

english: Whole grains provide more fibre and nutrients than refined grains.
sesotho: Lijo tse feletseng li fana ka li-fiber le limatlafatsi tse ngata ho feta lijo-thollo tse hloekisitsoeng.

english: Reduce intake of sugar, salt, and saturated fat.
sesotho: Fokotsa tsoekere, letsoai le mafura a mangata.

english: Drink at least eight glasses of clean water per day.
sesotho: Noa bonyane likhalase tse robeli tsa metsi a hloekileng ka letsatsi.

english: Dehydration causes headache, dizziness, and dark urine.
sesotho: Ho hloka metsi ho baka hlooho e bohloko, ho ferekana kelellong le ho ba le moroto o lefifi.

english: Breastfeeding is the best source of nutrition for infants.
sesotho: Ho anyesa masea ke mohloli o motle ka ho fetisisa oa phepo e nepahetseng bakeng sa masea.

english: Malnutrition weakens the immune system and increases infection risk.
sesotho: Ho se je hantle ho fokolisa tsamaiso ea 'mele ea ho itšireletsa mafung le ho eketsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english: Severe acute malnutrition requires therapeutic feeding.
sesotho: Ho se je hantle haholo ho feteletseng ho hloka hore motho a fepe ka tsela ea phekolo.

english: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness and increases infection risk.
sesotho: Ho haella ha vithamine A ho etsa hore motho a foufale bosiu 'me ho eketsa kotsi ea tšoaetso.

english: Iodine deficiency causes goitre and impairs brain development.
sesotho: Ho haella ha iodine ho etsa hore ho be le goitre 'me ho sitisa boko ho hōla.

english: Use iodised salt to prevent iodine deficiency.
sesotho: Sebelisa letsoai le nang le iodine ho thibela khaello ea iodine.

english: Iron deficiency is the most common nutritional deficiency worldwide.
sesotho: Ho haella ha tšepe ke ho haella ha phepo e nepahetseng ho atileng ka ho fetisisa lefatšeng.

english: Eat iron-rich foods such as meat, beans, and dark leafy vegetables.
sesotho: Ja lijo tse nang le tšepe e ngata tse kang nama, linaoa le meroho e nang le makhasi a lefifi.

english: Vitamin C improves the absorption of iron from plant foods.
sesotho: Vithamine C e ntlafatsa ho monya ha tšepe lijong tsa limela.

english: Zinc supports immune function and wound healing.
sesotho: Zinc e thusa hore tsamaiso ea 'mele ea ho itšireletsa mafung e sebetse le hore maqeba a fole.

english: Calcium is essential for strong bones and teeth.
sesotho: K'halsiamo e bohlokoa bakeng sa masapo le meno a matla.

english: Dairy products, fish, and leafy greens are good sources of calcium.
sesotho: Lihlahisoa tsa lebese, litlhapi le meroho ea makhasi ke mehloli e metle ea k'halsiamo.

english: Vitamin D is needed for calcium absorption.
sesotho: Vithamine D e hlokahala bakeng sa ho monya khalsiamo.

english: Sunlight exposure helps the body produce vitamin D.
sesotho: Ho pepesehela letsatsi ho thusa 'mele ho hlahisa vithamine D.

english: Obesity increases the risk of diabetes, heart disease, and certain cancers.
sesotho: Ho nona ho eketsa kotsi ea lefu la tsoekere, lefu la pelo le kankere e itseng.

english: Maintain a healthy weight through balanced diet and regular exercise.
sesotho: Boloka boima ba 'mele bo phetseng hantle ka ho ja lijo tse leka-lekaneng le ho ikoetlisa kamehla.

english: Avoid ultra-processed foods high in sugar, salt, and unhealthy fats.
sesotho: Qoba lijo tse nang le tsoekere e ngata, letsoai le mafura a sa pheleng hantle.

english: Read food labels to understand what you are eating.
sesotho: Bala mabitso a lijo ho utloisisa seo u se jang.

english: Cook with healthy oils such as canola or olive oil.
sesotho: Pheha ka oli e phetseng hantle e kang canola kapa oli ea mohloaare.

english: Limit red meat to two to three servings per week.
sesotho: Fokotsa nama e khubelu ho isa ho tse peli kapa tse tharo ka beke.

english: Eat fish at least twice a week for heart-healthy omega-3 fatty acids.
sesotho: Ja litlhapi bonyane ka makhetlo a mabeli ka beke e le hore u fumane mafura a omega-3 a nang le phepo e nepahetseng ea pelo.

english: Legumes such as lentils and beans are excellent sources of protein.
sesotho: Li-legumes tse kang lilense le linaoa ke mehloli e metle ea liprotheine.

english: Nuts and seeds provide healthy fats, protein, and fibre.
sesotho: Litholoana tsa linate le peo li fana ka mafura, liprotheine le fiber tse phetseng hantle.

english: Wash hands with soap before preparing or eating food.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho ka sesepa pele u lokisa kapa u ja lijo.

english: Wash all raw fruits and vegetables before eating.
sesotho: Hlatsoa litholoana tsohle tse tala le meroho pele u ja.

english: Keep raw meat separate from cooked food to prevent contamination.
sesotho: Boloka nama e tala e arohane le lijo tse phehiloeng e le hore e se ke ea silafala.

english: Use separate cutting boards for meat and vegetables.
sesotho: Sebelisa mapolanka a fapaneng a ho itšeha nama le meroho.

english: Cook meat to the correct internal temperature to kill bacteria.
sesotho: Pheha nama ka mocheso o nepahetseng oa ka hare ho bolaea libaktheria.

english: Refrigerate perishable foods within two hours of cooking.
sesotho: Pheha lijo tse senyehang ka sehatsetsing ka mor'a lihora tse peli u li phehile.

english: Do not eat food that smells or looks spoiled.
sesotho: U se ke ua ja lijo tse nkhang hampe kapa tse shebahalang li senyehile.

english: Safe food storage prevents foodborne illness.
sesotho: Ho boloka lijo ka tsela e sireletsehileng ho thibela mafu a tšoaetsanoang ke lijo.

english: Clean and disinfect food preparation surfaces regularly.
sesotho: Hloekisa le ho bolaea likokoana-hloko ka linako tsohle.

english: Wash dishes and utensils with hot soapy water.
sesotho: Hlatsoa lijana le lijana ka metsi a chesang a sesepa.

english: Brush your teeth twice a day with fluoride toothpaste.
sesotho: Hlatsoa meno habeli ka letsatsi ka setlolo sa meno se nang le fluoride.

english: Floss between your teeth once a day.
sesotho: Hang ka letsatsi u lokela ho phunya meno a hao.

english: Visit your dentist for a check-up every six months.
sesotho: E-ea ho ngaka ea meno 'me u e hlahlobe likhoeli tse ling le tse ling tse tšeletseng.

english: Reduce sugary food and drinks to prevent tooth decay.
sesotho: Fokotsa lijo le lino tse nang le tsoekere ho thibela ho bola ha meno.

english: Fluoride strengthens tooth enamel and prevents cavities.
sesotho: Fluoride e matlafatsa enamel ea meno 'me e thibela ho ruruha ha meno.

english: Wash your hands before eating and after using the toilet.
sesotho: Hlatsoa matsoho pele u ja le ka mor'a ho sebelisa ntloana.

english: Use soap and water for at least 20 seconds when washing hands.
sesotho: Sebelisa sesepa le metsi bonyane metsotsoana e 20 ha u hlatsoa matsoho.

english: Alcohol-based hand sanitiser is effective when soap is not available.
sesotho: Sesebelisoa se hloekisang matsoho se nang le joala se sebetsa hantle ha sesepa se le sieo.

english: Bathe or shower daily to maintain personal hygiene.
sesotho: Hlatsoa kapa u hlape letsatsi le leng le le leng e le hore u lule u hloekile.

english: Change and wash clothing regularly to prevent skin infections.
sesotho: Fetolela liaparo le ho li hlatsoa khafetsa e le hore u qobe tšoaetso ea letlalo.

english: Keep your home clean and well-ventilated.
sesotho: Boloka ntlo ea hao e hloekile 'me e fofa hantle.

english: Dispose of waste properly to prevent disease-carrying insects.
sesotho: Lahla litšila ka tsela e nepahetseng ho thibela likokoanyana tse tšoarang maloetse.

english: Use a covered rubbish bin to prevent flies and rodents.
sesotho: Sebelisa sebaka se koahetsoeng sa lithōle ho thibela lintsintsi le likokoanyana.

english: Clean your toilet regularly with disinfectant.
sesotho: Hloekisa ntloana ea hao kamehla ka ho sebelisa sesebelisoa se bolaeang likokoana-hloko.

english: Safe water storage prevents contamination after collection.
sesotho: Ho boloka metsi ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng ho thibela tšilafalo ka mor'a ho a bokella.

english: Cover water storage containers to prevent mosquito breeding.
sesotho: Koala likotlolo tsa metsi ho thibela ho ikatisa ha lintsintsi.

english: Boil water for one minute to make it safe for drinking.
sesotho: Pheha metsi ka motsotso o le mong e le hore a bolokehe bakeng sa ho nooa.

english: Water purification tablets can make unsafe water safe to drink.
sesotho: Li-tablet tsa ho hloekisa metsi li ka etsa hore metsi a sa sireletsehang a bolokehe ho noa.

english: Good sanitation and hygiene prevent the spread of many diseases.
sesotho: Tlhoekiso e ntle le bohloeki li thibela ho ata ha maloetse a mangata.

english: Open defecation spreads disease — always use a latrine or toilet.
sesotho: Ho qhalana ka ntle ho bulehileng ho jala lefu  kamehla sebelisa ntloana ea ho hlapela kapa ntloana.

english: Call emergency services immediately in a life-threatening situation.
sesotho: Bitsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso hang-hang maemong a sokelang bophelo.

english: Keep emergency numbers visible in your home.
sesotho: Boloka linomoro tsa maemo a tšohanyetso li bonahala ka tlung ea hao.

english: Check for danger before approaching an accident scene.
sesotho: Hlahloba hore na ho na le kotsi pele u atamela sebaka sa kotsi.

english: Check if the person is conscious by calling their name and tapping their shoulder.
sesotho: Hlahloba hore na motho eo o se a ntse a e-na le letsoalo ka ho bitsa lebitso la hae le ka ho otla lehetla la hae.

english: If the person is unconscious and not breathing, start CPR immediately.
sesotho: Haeba motho eo a sa tsebe letho 'me a sa phefumolohe, qala ho phomola hang-hang.

english: Place the heel of your hand on the centre of the chest for CPR.
sesotho: Beha letheka la letsoho la hao bohareng ba sefubeng bakeng sa CPR.

english: Press down firmly and fast — 100 to 120 compressions per minute.
sesotho: Tobetsa ka matla le ka potlako  100 ho isa ho 120 ka motsotso.

english: Give 30 chest compressions followed by two rescue breaths.
sesotho: Fana ka khatello ea sefubeng ea 30 e lateloang ke phefumoloho e 'meli ea pholoso.

english: Continue CPR until emergency services arrive.
sesotho: Tsoela pele ka ho phomola ho fihlela litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso li fihla.

english: Use an automated external defibrillator as soon as one is available.
sesotho: Sebelisa defibrillator e ikemetseng ea ka ntle hang ha e fumaneha.

english: Place an unconscious breathing person in the recovery position.
sesotho: Beha motho ea sa tsebeng letho ea phefumolohang boemong ba ho hlaphoheloa.

english: Tilt the head back and lift the chin to open the airway.
sesotho: Tlohela hlooho morao 'me u phahamise semumu e le hore u bule tsela ea ho hema.

english: A choking adult should be given five back blows followed by five abdominal thrusts.
sesotho: Motho e moholo ea nyoriloeng o lokela ho otloa ka makhetlo a mahlano ka morao 'me a lateloe ke ho sutumetsoa ha mpa ka makhetlo a mahlano.

english: Do not perform abdominal thrusts on a pregnant woman or infant.
sesotho: U se ke ua beha mpa ka mpeng ea mosali eaimana kapa lesea.

english: For a choking infant, give five back blows between the shoulder blades.
sesotho: Bakeng sa lesea le nyoriloeng, le lokela ho otloa ka makhetlo a mahlano ka morao pakeng tsa mahetla.

english: Control bleeding by applying firm, direct pressure to the wound.
sesotho: Laola ho tsoa mali ka ho sebelisa matla, ho hatella leqeba ka ho toba.

english: Elevate a bleeding limb above the level of the heart.
sesotho: Phahamisa setho se nang le mali ka holimo ho pelo.

english: Do not remove an object embedded in a wound.
sesotho: U se ke ua tlosa ntho e kenngoa leqeba.

english: Apply a tourniquet only for life-threatening limb bleeding.
sesotho: Sebelisa turniquet feela bakeng sa ho tsoa mali a kotsi.

english: Clean a wound with clean running water for at least five minutes.
sesotho: Hlatsoa ntho e leqeba ka metsi a hloekileng a phallang bonyane metsotso e mehlano.

english: Cover a clean wound with a sterile dressing.
sesotho: Koala ntho e hloekileng ka seaparo se sa hloekang.

english: Seek medical care for deep, dirty, or animal bite wounds.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka bakeng sa maqeba a tebileng, a litšila kapa a loma ke phoofolo.

english: For burns, cool the burn with cool running water for 20 minutes.
sesotho: Bakeng sa ho chesoa, pholisa ho chesoa ka metsi a pholileng a phallang metsotso e 20.

english: Do not apply ice, butter, or toothpaste to a burn.
sesotho: U se ke ua sebelisa leqhoa, botoro kapa sesepa sa meno ha u chesa.

english: Cover a burn with a clean, non-fluffy material.
sesotho: Koala ho chesoa ka lintho tse hloekileng, tse se nang li-fluffy.

english: Seek medical care for burns larger than the size of the patient's hand.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka bakeng sa ho chesoa ho fetang boholo ba letsoho la mokuli.

english: For a suspected broken bone, immobilise the limb and seek medical care.
sesotho: Haeba ho belaelloa hore masapo a robehile, emisa ho tsamaea 'me u batle thuso ea bongaka.

english: Do not try to straighten a suspected fracture.
sesotho: U se ke ua leka ho lokisa ho robeha ho belaelloang.

english: For a spinal injury, do not move the person unless they are in danger.
sesotho: Bakeng sa kotsi ea mokokotlo, u se ke ua tsamaisa motho eo ntle le haeba a le kotsing.

english: For a nosebleed, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose.
sesotho: Haeba u tsoa mali ka nko, u lokela ho otlolla sefahleho ebe u hatakela karolo e bonolo ea nko.

english: Hold the nose for 10 minutes without releasing.
sesotho: Tšoara nko ka metsotso e 10 u sa e lokolle.

english: Seek medical care if a nosebleed does not stop after 20 minutes.
sesotho: Batla tlhokomelo ea bongaka haeba mali a tsoang nko a sa khaotse ka mor'a metsotso e 20.

english: For a suspected poisoning, call the poison control centre immediately.
sesotho: Haeba u belaela hore u na le chefo, letsetsa setsi sa thibelo ea chefo hang-hang.

english: Do not induce vomiting unless instructed by a medical professional.
sesotho: U se ke ua hlohlelletsa ho hlatsa ntle le haeba u laetsoe ke setsebi sa bongaka.

english: For an electric shock, do not touch the person until the power is off.
sesotho: Haeba ho e-na le motlakase, u se ke ua ama motho eo ho fihlela motlakase o tima.

english: For a drowning victim, remove from water and start CPR if not breathing.
sesotho: Bakeng sa motho ea imelang, tlosa metsi 'me u qale ho phomola ka pelo haeba a sa phefumolohe.

english: For a snake bite, keep the person calm and immobilise the bitten limb.
sesotho: Ha noha e loma motho eo, mo boloke a khobile matšoafo 'me u thibele setho se lomalitsoeng.

english: Do not cut, suck, or apply a tourniquet to a snake bite.
sesotho: U se ke ua khaola, ua anya kapa ua sebelisa li-turniquet ha u loma noha.

english: Transport snake bite victims to hospital as quickly as possible.
sesotho: Fetisetsa batho ba lemetseng ho loma linoha sepetlele kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang.

english: For anaphylaxis, administer epinephrine immediately if available.
sesotho: Bakeng sa anaphylaxis, fa epinephrine hang-hang haeba e fumaneha.

english: Lay the person flat and elevate the legs during anaphylactic shock.
sesotho: Beha motho eo fatše 'me u phahamise maoto nakong ea ho ts'oaroa ke anaphylactic.

english: Call emergency services immediately for anaphylaxis.
sesotho: Bitsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso hang-hang bakeng sa anaphylaxis.

english: For a diabetic hypoglycaemic episode, give sugar or a sweet drink.
sesotho: Bakeng sa lefu la tsoekere le nang le lefu la tsoekere, fa tsoekere kapa seno se monate.

english: If the person is unconscious, do not give anything by mouth.
sesotho: Haeba motho eo a hloka tsebo, u se ke ua mo fa letho ka molomo.

english: For heat stroke, move the person to a cool place and cool them rapidly.
sesotho: Bakeng sa ho chesoa ke mocheso, isa motho sebakeng se pholileng 'me u mo pholile ka potlako.

english: For hypothermia, warm the person gradually with blankets.
sesotho: Bakeng sa hypothermia, futhumatsa motho butle-butle ka likobo.

english: For a seizure, protect the person from injury and time the seizure.
sesotho: Ha motho a tšoaroa ke sefuba, mo sireletse hore a se ke a tsoa likotsi 'me u mo fe nako ea hore a tšoaroe ke sefuba.

english: Do not restrain a person having a seizure.
sesotho: U se ke ua thibela motho ea nang le tlhaselo.

english: For an eye injury, do not rub the eye.
sesotho: Haeba u lemetse leihlo, u se ke ua le phunya.

english: Flush a chemical eye injury with clean water for 15 to 20 minutes.
sesotho: Hlatsoa leihlo le lemetseng ka lik'hemik'hale ka metsi a hloekileng metsotso e 15 ho isa ho e 20.

english: For a dislocated joint, immobilise and seek medical care.
sesotho: Haeba u e-na le mokokotlo o senyehileng, u se ke ua tsamaea 'me u batle thuso ea bongaka.

english: For a suspected heart attack, give aspirin and call emergency services.
sesotho: Haeba u belaela hore u na le lefu la pelo, u lokela ho fana ka aspirin 'me u letsetse litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso.

english: For a stroke, note the time of symptom onset and call emergency services.
sesotho: Ha u e-na le stroke, hlokomela nako eo matšoao a qalang ka eona 'me u letsetse litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso.

english: Keep a well-stocked first aid kit in your home and vehicle.
sesotho: Boloka thepa e lekaneng ea liphallelo tsa pele lapeng la hao le koloing.

english: Check and replace expired items in your first aid kit regularly.
sesotho: Hlahloba le ho nkela lintho tse sa sebetseng tse ka kiteng ea hau ea thuso ea pele sebaka kamehla.

english: Learn basic first aid — it can save a life.
sesotho: Ithute thuso ea pele ea motheo e ka pholosang bophelo.

english: Attend a first aid course to learn life-saving skills.
sesotho: E-ea thupelong ea liphallelo tsa pele e le hore u ithute tsebo e pholosang bophelo.

english: Stay calm in an emergency — panic makes the situation worse.
sesotho: Lula u khobile matšoafo maemong a tšohanyetso  Tšabo e mpefatsa boemo.

english: Reassure the injured person while waiting for help.
sesotho: Khothatsa motho ea lemetseng ha a ntse a emetse thuso.

english: Do not leave an injured or unconscious person alone.
sesotho: U se ke ua tlohela motho ea lemetseng kapa ea sa tsebeng letho a le mong.

english: Mental health is as important as physical health.
sesotho: Bophelo bo botle ba kelello bo bohlokoa joaloka bophelo bo botle ba 'mele.

english: One in four people will experience a mental health problem in their lifetime.
sesotho: Motho a le mong ho ba bane o tla ba le bothata ba kelello bophelong ba hae.

english: Mental illness is not a sign of weakness.
sesotho: Ho kula kelellong hase pontšo ea bofokoli.

english: Seek help early if you are struggling with your mental health.
sesotho: Batla thuso esale pele haeba u loana le mathata a kelello.

english: Talking to someone you trust can help when you are feeling low.
sesotho: Ho bua le motho eo u mo tšepang ho ka u thusa ha u ikutloa u nyahame.

english: Depression is more than just feeling sad — it is a medical condition.
sesotho: Ho tepella maikutlo ha ho bolele feela hore u utloile bohloko.

english: Symptoms of depression include persistent sadness, loss of interest, and fatigue.
sesotho: Matšoao a ho tepella maikutlo a kenyelletsa ho lula u saretsoe, ho lahleheloa ke thahasello le mokhathala.

english: Anxiety is a normal response to stress but can become a disorder.
sesotho: Ho tšoenyeha ke tsela e tloaelehileng ea ho sebetsana le khatello ea maikutlo empa ho ka fetoha bothata.

english: Symptoms of anxiety include excessive worry, restlessness, and difficulty sleeping.
sesotho: Matšoao a ho tšoenyeha a akarelletsa ho tšoenyeha haholo, ho tšoenyeha le ho hlobaela.

english: Cognitive behavioural therapy is an effective treatment for depression and anxiety.
sesotho: Kalafo ea boitšoaro ea kelello ke phekolo e atlehang ea ho tepella maikutlo le ho tšoenyeha.

english: Antidepressants take two to four weeks to show their full effect.
sesotho: Li-antidepressant li nka libeke tse peli ho isa ho tse 'nè hore li bontše phello ea tsona e feletseng.

english: Do not stop antidepressants suddenly — reduce the dose gradually.
sesotho: U se ke ua khaotsa ho sebelisa lithethefatsi tse loantšang khatello ea maikutlo ka tšohanyetso  fokotsa tekanyo butle-butle.

english: Post-traumatic stress disorder can develop after a traumatic event.
sesotho: Ho ka 'na ha e-ba le khatello ea maikutlo ka mor'a hore ho hlahe ntho e bohloko.

english: PTSD symptoms include flashbacks, nightmares, and avoidance.
sesotho: Matšoao a PTSD a kenyelletsa ho hopola lintho tse etsahetseng, litoro tse bohloko le ho li qoba.

english: Trauma-focused therapy is effective for PTSD.
sesotho: Phekolo e shebaneng le ho lemala ha kelello e sebetsa hantle bakeng sa PTSD.

english: Bipolar disorder involves episodes of mania and depression.
sesotho: Ho tšoaroa ke lefu la bipolar ho akarelletsa ho tšoaroa ke mania le ho tepella maikutlo.

english: Mood stabilisers help control the symptoms of bipolar disorder.
sesotho: Lisebelisoa tsa ho tsitsisa maikutlo li thusa ho laola matšoao a lefu lena.

english: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness that affects thinking and perception.
sesotho: Schizophrenia ke lefu le tebileng la kelello le amang monahano le maikutlo.

english: Antipsychotic medication is the main treatment for schizophrenia.
sesotho: Meriana e khahlanong le mafu a kelello ke eona e ka sehloohong e ka phekolang lefu la 'dementia'.

english: Regular follow-up is essential for managing schizophrenia.
sesotho: Tlhokomelo ea kamehla ke ea bohlokoa bakeng sa ho laola lefu la schizophrenia.

english: Substance use disorders are treatable medical conditions.
sesotho: Mathata a bakoang ke ho sebelisa lithethefatsi a ka phekoloa.

english: Alcohol dependence requires medical supervision during withdrawal.
sesotho: Ho itšetleha ka joala ho hloka tlhokomelo ea bongaka nakong ea ho khaotsa ho noa.

english: Seek help from a healthcare provider to quit smoking.
sesotho: Kōpa thuso ho mofani oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo hore u khaotse ho tsuba.

english: Nicotine replacement therapy doubles the chances of quitting smoking.
sesotho: Kalafo ea ho nka nicotine e tla eketsa menyetla ea ho khaotsa ho tsuba ka makhetlo a mabeli.

english: Drug rehabilitation programmes support recovery from substance use.
sesotho: Mananeo a ntlafatso ea lithethefatsi a tšehetsa ho hlaphoheloa ha motho ha a sebelisitse lithethefatsi.

english: Suicide is preventable — seek help immediately if you have suicidal thoughts.
sesotho: Ho ka thibeloa ho ipolaea  batla thuso hang-hang haeba u na le menahano ea ho ipolaea.

english: Talk openly about suicide — asking does not increase the risk.
sesotho: Ho bua phatlalatsa ka ho ipolaea  ho botsa ha ho eketse kotsi.

english: Remove access to means of self-harm during a mental health crisis.
sesotho: Tlosa mokhoa oa ho iketsa kotsi nakong ea koluoa ea kelello.

english: Crisis helplines provide immediate support for mental health emergencies.
sesotho: Mehala ea thuso ea likoluoa e fana ka tšehetso e potlakileng bakeng sa maemo a tšohanyetso a bophelo bo botle ba kelello.

english: Support from family and friends is vital for mental health recovery.
sesotho: Tšehetso e tsoang ho ba lelapa le metsoalle ke ea bohlokoa bakeng sa ho hlaphoheloa kelellong.

english: Stigma prevents many people from seeking mental health care.
sesotho: Batho ba bangata ha ba fumane tlhokomelo ea kelello ka lebaka la ho tšoaroa hampe.

english: Educating communities about mental health reduces stigma.
sesotho: Ho ruta sechaba ka bophelo bo botle ba kelello ho fokotsa ho nyenyefatsoa.

english: Children and adolescents can also experience mental health problems.
sesotho: Bana le bacha le bona ba ka ba le mathata a kelello.

english: Bullying increases the risk of depression and anxiety in young people.
sesotho: Ho hlekefetsoa ho eketsa kotsi ea ho tepella maikutlo le ho tšoenyeha ho bacha.

english: Screen time should be limited for children's mental well-being.
sesotho: Nako ea ho shebella skrine e lokela ho ba e fokolang bakeng sa bophelo bo botle ba kelello ba bana.

english: Physical activity improves mood and reduces symptoms of depression.
sesotho: Ho ikoetlisa ho ntlafatsa maikutlo le ho fokotsa matšoao a ho tepella maikutlo.

english: Regular exercise releases endorphins that improve mental well-being.
sesotho: Ho ikoetlisa kamehla ho lokolla li-endorphin tse ntlafatsang bophelo ba kelello.

english: Adequate sleep is essential for mental health.
sesotho: Boroko bo lekaneng ke ba bohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo bo botle ba kelello.

english: Adults need seven to nine hours of sleep per night.
sesotho: Batho ba baholo ba hloka ho robala lihora tse supileng ho isa ho tse robong ka bosiu.

english: Poor sleep worsens symptoms of depression and anxiety.
sesotho: Ho robala hantle ho mpefatsa matšoao a ho tepella maikutlo le ho tšoenyeha.

english: Establish a regular sleep routine to improve sleep quality.
sesotho: Etsa hore u robale kamehla e le hore u ntlafatse boleng ba boroko ba hao.

english: Limit caffeine and screen use before bedtime.
sesotho: Fokotsa ho noa caffeine le ho sebelisa li-screen pele u robala.

english: Mindfulness and meditation reduce stress and improve mental well-being.
sesotho: Ho nahanisisa le ho thuisa ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo le ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba kelello.

english: Deep breathing exercises can reduce anxiety quickly.
sesotho: Ho ikoetlisa ka ho hema ka botebo ho ka fokotsa matšoenyeho kapele.

english: Social connection protects against depression and loneliness.
sesotho: Ho ba le kamano e ntle le batho ba bang ho ba sireletsa hore ba se ke ba nyahama le ho jeoa ke bolutu.

english: Volunteering and helping others improves mental well-being.
sesotho: Ho ithaopa le ho thusa ba bang ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba kelello.

english: Set realistic goals to build confidence and reduce stress.
sesotho: Ipehele lipakane tse utloahalang tse tla u thusa hore u itšepe le ho fokotsa khatello ea maikutlo.

english: Practise gratitude daily to improve mental outlook.
sesotho: Itloaetse ho leboha letsatsi le leng le le leng e le hore u ntlafatse tsela eo u talimang lintho ka eona.

english: Spend time in nature to reduce stress and improve mood.
sesotho: Iphe nako ea ho phomola ka tlhaho e le hore u fokotse khatello ea maikutlo le ho ntlafatsa maikutlo.

english: Hobbies and creative activities support mental well-being.
sesotho: Ho itlosa bolutu le mesebetsi ea ho bōpa ho tšehetsa bophelo bo botle ba kelello.

english: Work-life balance is important for long-term mental health.
sesotho: Ho leka-lekanya mosebetsi le bophelo ba motho ke habohlokoa bakeng sa bophelo bo botle ba kelello ka nako e telele.

english: Recognise the signs of burnout — exhaustion, cynicism, and reduced performance.
sesotho: Tseba matšoao a ho felloa ke matla  ho khathala, ho ba le masisa-pelo le ho fokotseha ha mosebetsi.

english: Take regular breaks during work to maintain focus and well-being.
sesotho: Etsa khefu khafetsa nakong ea mosebetsi e le hore u lule u tsepamisitse maikutlo le ho phela hantle.

english: Grief is a normal response to loss and takes time.
sesotho: Ho sareloa ke tsela e tloaelehileng ea ho itšoara ha motho a hlokahalletsoe 'me ho nka nako.

english: Seek professional support if grief is interfering with daily life.
sesotho: Batla tšehetso ea litsebi haeba masoabi a sitisa bophelo ba letsatsi le letsatsi.

english: Dementia is a progressive condition affecting memory and thinking.
sesotho: Lefu la kelello ke boemo bo tsoelang pele bo amang mohopolo le ho nahana.

english: Early diagnosis of dementia allows for better planning and support.
sesotho: Ho fumanoa ha 'dementia esale pele ho etsa hore ho be le moralo le tšehetso e molemo.

english: Cognitive stimulation activities help maintain brain function in dementia.
sesotho: Mesebetsi ea ho susumetsa kelello e thusa ho boloka boko bo sebetsa hantle ha motho a e-na le 'dementia'.

english: Carers of people with dementia need support and respite.
sesotho: Batho ba hlokomelang batho ba nang le 'dementia' ba hloka tšehetso le phomolo.

english: A healthy lifestyle in midlife reduces the risk of dementia.
sesotho: Mokhoa o phetseng hantle oa bophelo bo botle bohareng ba lilemo o fokotsa kotsi ea 'dementia'.
